$comment: Public codebases quirk is judged on, pinned to a commit and analysed as files only: their PostCSS configs are never loaded and nothing is installed or run. Add your own held-out projects to eval/corpora.local.json (same shape, with "local": "<path>" instead of repo/rev); it is gitignored.
